infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: CallBridge shows your words as you speak, so you can see exactly what the assistant will get.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CallBridge uses the microphone while you hold the talk button, and when you join a call yourself.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CallBridge doesn't use your photos. This is required by a system library the app includes.

plugins.microphonePermission: CallBridge uses the microphone so you can tell the assistant who to call and what to say.

plugins.iosMicrophonePermission: CallBridge uses the microphone so you can tell the assistant who to call and what to say.

plugins.contactsPermission: CallBridge lets you pick someone from your contacts to call. It only reads the person you pick.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: CallBridge uses your location to find businesses near you when you ask for the nearest one.

plugins.writeOnlyCalendarPermission: CallBridge adds appointments it booked for you to your calendar. It never reads your calendar.
